name: io.github.cole-h06/omneum
description: Evaluate source reliability, dependent evidence, and conflicting claims in your agent's context.
title: Omneum

installation.instructions: Using a Python 3.11–3.14 virtual environment, run python -m pip install 'omneum==1.1.0', then omneum install from your normal login account, without sudo. Approve administrator access when requested. Run command -v omneum-server. For direct stdio configuration, use that absolute executable path as the client's command. Alternatively, import the MCPB in a compatible host with Node.js >=18 and select that path. Use the same login account. Node.js is required only for the MCPB launcher. The published launcher bundle remains version 1.0.4; use these 1.1.0 installation instructions instead of its embedded 1.0.4 guidance. The connector requires the installed evaluator service and does not install the package or daemon.
installation.runtime: Host-provided Node.js >=18 for the MCPB launcher; Python 3.11–3.14 for Omneum.
